method: Combinational SAT of rotating ROB/CSB scans versus fixed physical entries with newest-age selection.
assumptions: CSB valid entries equal the circular interval starting at csb_head with csb_count entries.
Capacities are powers of two; heads and ROB IDs fit the capacity.
unconstrained_inputs: Store word-address equality, arbitrary 32-bit data, byte masks, data/address readiness, validity and fault presence.
Load word address, requested-byte mask and ROB age.
observables: Requested-byte blocking and concrete blocking-store owner.
Forwarded-byte presence/data and producer ROB owner for requested unblocked bytes.
scope_notes: Eight-bit word tags represent arbitrary equality patterns among the at most 17 addresses in the eight-entry instance.
Stale data on blocked or unrequested bytes is unobservable and excluded.
This is a combinational forwarding proof, not a proof of the full CPU.
